record.question: What is the least literate district in Mizoram according to 2011 census?
record.explanation: Answer D: Lawngtlai district. The Mizoram government’s census-based Economic Survey gives Lawngtlai the lowest 2011 district literacy rate (65.88%), below the other listed districts. Reference: https://finance.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/163ee8e3d9a10a63bbda2865732780e0/mizoram-economic-survey-2014-15.pdf; https://lawngtlai.nic.in/demography/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
